services.name: Space Rentals at FPCT
services.desc: We are thrilled to be able to partner with so many wonderful community groups in service to the great work that happens in Baltimore! It is one of our favorite things to do, especially because we know affordable space is hard to come by! However: Our space rental program is secondary to our mainstage and educational programming. We will rarely be able to accommodate requests or even requests for information with short notice. Most rental partnerships are usually planned several months in advance. We receive an extremely high volume of requests for space, and they are answered in order as volunteer time allows. It is not unusual for us to need some time to get back to you. Repeated,
